sloka: अहो दुर्वृत्तमास्थाय नात्मानं वैजुगुप्सते ।सर्वथा सदृशस्तावद्विक्रमो ऽस्य दुरात्मनः ।। ७.२४.१९ ॥
transliteration: aho durvṛttamāsthāya nātmānaṁ vaijugupsate ।sarvathā sadṛśastāvadvikramo 'sya durātmanaḥ ।। 7.24.19 ॥

translations.english: Alas, having resorted to evil conduct, he indeed does not despise himself, and in every way, the valor of this wicked one is indeed fitting.
